description: Use after search_hotels when the user wants details or a booking link for one property. Input: slug from search_hotels (e.g. 'hotel-nordic'). Returns every verified fact with its source URL and check date, notes from the official site, public contact, detected booking engine, record page, JSON API URL and booking_link (redirect to the official website with src=entityindex). No prices or photos.
